description:
About Us:

Homebound is on a mission to make it possible for anyone, anywhere, to build a home using technology. Created by an experienced team of construction, real estate, design, and technology experts, Homebound is transforming the residential construction industry by improving the costly and inefficient process of building a home. 

We’ve created an entirely new way to build homes with technology powering every stage from start to finish to provide a seamless experience for our customers. Homeowners across the country can choose where they want to live, select a home plan that’s perfect for them, then personalize and buy it, all online. Homebound has raised $150M in capital from leading venture capitalists like Google, Khosla, Thrive Ventures, and we’re scaling quickly in places like Texas, Colorado and Florida. Come build your future with us.

About the Role:

This is an early-stage app with huge expansion planned this year — a rare opportunity for a designer who wants to define the vision for a mobile product from the ground up. As Senior Product Designer, you will define how AI feels for the teams building our homes. You'll shape the experiences that our Superintendents and Direct Construction Operators (DCOs) rely on every day—across our mobile application, advanced AI based video analysis, and new experiences around automated data capture on site.

This is a role for a designer who blends sharp interaction design with strong visual craft. You'll take novel, sometimes ambiguous AI capabilities—computer vision, multimodal models, agents—and turn them into interfaces that feel clear, trustworthy, and genuinely delightful on a jobsite. You know the emerging patterns for designing with AI (surfacing confidence, handling uncertainty, guiding and correcting the model) and you have a point of view on how to make them feel effortless for users who are not sitting at a desk.

You're also an exceptional communicator: helping craft executive level presentations that carry Homebound's AI narrative across the entire company, our board, and our investors.

What You'll Do:

  • Own the end-to-end experience: Design interaction flows and polished, high-craft visuals across all of our field initiatives.

  • Design compelling AI patterns: Turn frontier AI capabilities into interfaces that are clear and trustworthy—handling confidence, uncertainty, and human-in-the-loop correction in delightful ways.

  • Design for the field, not the desk: Craft mobile-first experiences that work for Superintendents and DCOs in real jobsite conditions.

  • Bring experiences to life with motion: Use motion design where it counts to make AI interactions feel intuitive, responsive, and compelling.

  • Partner tightly with your PM and engineers: Work shoulder-to-shoulder with the Field AI PM and Engineering to move from concept to shipped product.

  • Communicate the AI story: Present to executives and teams across the company, using your work to make Homebound's AI vision tangible and shared.

What You'll Bring:

  • A portfolio showcasing highly polished mobile app case studies, demonstrating strong interaction design and high visual craft.

  • 5+ years of product design experience, with direct experience designing mobile applications (iOS strongly preferred).

  • Hands-on experience integrating AI/ML patterns into products in delightful, usable ways.

  • Exceptional communication and storytelling skills, including direct experience presenting to executive-level audiences.

  • Comfort designing in ambiguity—translating novel, evolving AI capabilities into clear, intuitive experiences.

  • A collaborative, self-starting approach; you partner naturally across product, engineering, and operations.

  • Interest in construction and the built environment is a plus; no prior industry experience required, but an expectation to learn the domain rapidly.

Our Commitment:

We are focused on building a diverse and inclusive workforce. If you’re excited about this role, but do not meet 100% of the qualifications listed above, we encourage you to apply. To apply, please submit an application with your resume on the Career’s page.

Homebound is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetics or any other basis forbidden under federal, state, or local law. Homebound considers all qualified applicants in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Our Compensation Philosophy:

Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Please note that the salary range displayed on each job posting may vary by state. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter will share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process. Please note that each job posting includes a general description of any other compensation offered for the position in addition to the salary range displayed on the job posting. You can find information about our benefits here.
